subject.title: Feature: Message continuation marker for batched input (cost savings)

question: Should OpenClaw support explicit user-authored continuation semantics, and if so should the permanent owner be core configuration or a generic plugin aggregation seam?
rationale: Existing debounce and collect behavior only partially addresses the use case, while the proposed solution adds cross-channel session semantics and several public configuration choices that repository policy does not resolve automatically.

options.title: Design generic aggregation seam
options.body: Add a shared pre-agent aggregation contract and make marker continuation one policy only after its lifecycle and plugin boundary are defined.

options.title: Keep timer-based batching
options.body: Treat renewable inbound debounce plus collect mode as the supported solution, improve documentation, and decline a separate marker protocol.

options.title: Add direct core marker config
options.body: Implement typed continuation marker and timeout settings directly in core with cross-channel lifecycle, upgrade, and interaction tests.

recommendation.title: Design generic aggregation seam
recommendation.body: Add a shared pre-agent aggregation contract and make marker continuation one policy only after its lifecycle and plugin boundary are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history and discussion signals connect this person to the shared inbound debounce and queue product boundary.
